interest: Japan extends military volunteering to Taiwan, 1941.
overview: Grew's 1941 telegram: Japan will start voluntary military service in Taiwan, as in Korea.

subfiles.about: Telegram reporting a Japanese cabinet decision to establish voluntary military service in Taiwan modeled on the 1938 Korean system.
subfiles.summary: Grew reports Japan's plan for voluntary military service in Taiwan, framed as assimilation.
subfiles.title: Telegram from Grew (Tokyo) on Voluntary Military Service in Taiwan
